paper_metadata.title: Coarse-to-Fine Vision-Language Pre-training with Fusion in the Backbone
paper_metadata.abstract: Vision-language (VL) pre-training has recently received considerable attention. However, most existing end-to-end pre-training approaches either only aim to tackle VL tasks such as image-text retrieval, visual question answering (VQA) and image captioning that test high-level understanding of images, or only target region-level understanding for tasks such as phrase grounding and object detection. We present FIBER (Fusion-In-the-Backbone-based transformER), a new VL model architecture that can seamlessly handle both these types of tasks. Instead of having dedicated transformer layers for fusion after the uni-modal backbones, FIBER pushes multimodal fusion deep into the model by inserting cross-attention into the image and text backbones, bringing gains in terms of memory and performance. In addition, unlike previous work that is either only pre-trained on image-text data or on fine-grained data with box-level annotations, we present a two-stage pre-training strategy that uses both these kinds of data efficiently: (i) coarse-grained pre-training based on image-text data; followed by (ii) fine-grained pre-training based on image-text-box data. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a wide range of VL tasks, ranging from VQA, image captioning, and retrieval, to phrase grounding, referring expression comprehension, and object detection. Using deep multimodal fusion coupled with the two-stage pre-training, FIBER provides consistent performance improvements over strong baselines across all tasks, often outperforming methods using magnitudes more data. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/FIBER.

extraction_data.innovation: Coarse-to-fine two-stage pre-training pipeline; unified architecture that switches between a dual encoder (for fast retrieval) and a fusion encoder (for VQA/captioning) by toggling cross-attention modules; end-to-end support for both image-level and region-level tasks without task-specific architectures.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Web-harvested image-text data, image-text-box data with ground-truth box annotations
extraction_data.application: VQA, image captioning, image-text retrieval, phrase grounding, referring expression comprehension, object detection
extraction_data.research_problem: Unified vision-language pre-training for image-level and region-level tasks
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Image-text matching, masked language modeling, image-text contrastive loss, bounding box localization loss, word-region alignment loss
extraction_data.finetuning_task: VQA, image captioning, retrieval, grounding, object detection
extraction_data.finetuning_data: VQAv2, NLVR2, COCO captioning, NoCaps, COCO and Flickr30k image-text retrieval, Flickr30kEntities, referring expression comprehension, COCO and LVIS detection, 13 object detection in the wild datasets
extraction_data.hardware_description: 64 A100 GPUs for coarse-grained pre-training; 64 V100 GPUs for fine-grained pre-training
extraction_data.extension: Switching on/off cross-attention modules to adapt between dual encoder and fusion encoder modes; adding an object detection head for grounding/detection
extraction_data.paper_title: Coarse-to-Fine Vision-Language Pre-training with Fusion in the Backbone
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Cross-attention fusion inserted into encoding layers of the backbone
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Coarse-grained pre-training (low-res 384x384, image-text matching, MLM, contrastive loss) -> fine-grained pre-training (high-res 800x1333, bounding box localization, word-region alignment, initialized from coarse model)
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Cross-attention fusion (switchable between dual encoder and fusion encoder)

extraction_data.innovation: Coarse-to-fine vision-language pre-training with fusion in the backbone: inserts cross-attention modules into the top layers of pre-trained vision (Swin) and text (RoBERTa) encoders to produce text-aware image features and language-aware text features during fine-grained pre-training, unlike prior work (e.g., GLIP) that fuses modalities only in the detection head or after feature extraction.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Coarse-to-fine vision-language pre-training (object grounding, phrase grounding, image-text matching)
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: COCO, ConceptualCaptions, SBUCaptions, VisualGenome (coarse-grained); MDETR-curated data, Objects365 (fine-grained)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised discriminative fine-tuning for VQA, retrieval, captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, Image captioning, open-ended VQA, grounding
extraction_data.application: Object detection, phrase grounding, visual question answering (VQA), image-text retrieval, captioning, referring expression comprehension
extraction_data.paper_title: Coarse-to-Fine Vision-Language Pre-training with Fusion in the Backbone
extraction_data.finetuning_data: COCO, VQAv2, NLVR2, Flickr30k, NoCaps, Flickr30k entities, RefCOCO, RefCOCOg, LVIS, ODinW
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Cross-attention modules inserted into top 6 blocks of vision and text encoders
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Coarse-grained pre-training -> Fine-grained pre-training -> Downstream task adaptation
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Cross-attention fusion inserted into backbone layers
extraction_data.benchmark_result: COCO: 54.5; VQAv2: 78.22; NLVR2: 78.37; Flickr30k: 84.41; COCO test-P: 81.2; COCO CIDEr: SOTA for base-size models; Flickr30k entities: 96.1/97.4; RefCOCO val/testA/testB: 90.68/92.59/87.26; RefCOCO+: 85.74/90.13/79.38; RefCOCOg: 87.11/87.32; COCO OD: 49.3/58.4 AP; LVIS MiniVal AP: 29.5/50.0

extraction_data.innovation: Coarse-to-fine vision-language pre-training with fusion in the backbone; introduces a ladder architecture to align pre-training and fine-tuning objectives; applies CIDEr optimization for image captioning; demonstrates that SwinTransformer+RoBERTa is the optimal backbone pairing for region-level tasks.
